OBSERVED.definition: Directly acquired empirical environmental, infrastructural, and spatial data from physical sensors or statutory surveys.

DERIVED.definition: Mathematically computed features, indices, and zonal statistics transformed directly from raw observations without behavioral or simulation models.

MODELED.definition: Synthesized risk indices, spatial autocorrelations, optimization decision allocations, and projected microclimatic scenario responses.

VERIFIED.definition: Post-implementation empirical physical observations passing formal MRV quality control and causal attribution standards.

transition_prerequisites.PROPOSED: Requires immutable optimization run reference, validated scope, explicit budget breakdown, and 13-section machine-readable document.
transition_prerequisites.FUNDED: Requires formal sanction identifier, approved capital allocation, and funding entity metadata.
transition_prerequisites.IMPLEMENTED: Requires physical completion evidence and signed contractor implementation events with planned vs implemented quantities.
transition_prerequisites.MONITORING: Requires baseline reference confirmation, post-stabilization period elapsed, and active observation event logging.
transition_prerequisites.VERIFIED: Requires complete implementation events, post-intervention satellite/sensor observation, 100% passing MRV quality control audit, empirical impact measurement, and certified third-party verification event record.

financial_components.modeled_optimized_cost_inr: Deterministic cost output from HiGHS solver under F-24.3 (CapEx + fixed mobilization).
financial_components.approved_project_budget_inr: Statutory municipal budget or grant allocation approved by funding entity.
financial_components.actual_expenditure_inr: Audited financial ledger expenditure disbursed during physical execution (classified as NOT_AVAILABLE at proposal stage).
financial_components.remaining_budget_inr: Approved project budget minus actual expenditure.

project_budget_structure.immutability_rule: Modeled cost cannot be retroactively modified to match approved budget or actual expenditure. All three values must remain independently tracked.

allocation_immutability_and_revision_pol.canonical_allocation_rule: The output of an optimization run (canonical_optimization_allocation.parquet) is write-once, immutable, cryptographic evidence.
allocation_immutability_and_revision_pol.revision_branching_rule: If human planners or stakeholders adjust allocated quantities, the system creates a distinct PROPOSED_REVISION entity recording original_quantity, proposed_quantity, revision_delta, revision_reason, author_identity, and timestamp.
allocation_immutability_and_revision_pol.original_provenance_preservation: The original solver allocation is never overwritten or mutated.

baseline_indicators.description: Environmental, physical, and demographic state prior to intervention execution.

modeled_indicators.description: Simulated future microclimatic relief and risk reduction under scenario assumptions.

verified_indicators.description: Post-intervention empirical measurements that have passed MRV quality control.
verified_indicators.prerequisite: Requires real-world physical implementation and post-deployment sensor acquisition.

implementation_event_schema.deviation_rate: float or null ((implemented - planned) / planned; null/undefined when planned is 0.0)

observation_event_schema.sensor_platform: string (e.g. Landsat-8/9 OLI/TIRS, Sentinel-2 MSI [optical only], Drone Thermal Radiometric, In-situ pyrometer)

quality_control_criteria.spatial_coverage_check: Observation must cover 100% of treated H3 cells with clear pixels.
quality_control_criteria.temporal_window_comparability: Post-implementation overpass must match baseline seasonal pre-monsoon window: Preferred window DOY 95-115; Fallback window DOY 90-120 subject to maximum offset <= 15 days from canonical target DOY 105. DOY is the canonical representation; calendar dates derive from acquisition year to preserve leap-year validity.
quality_control_criteria.cloud_shadow_screening: Source scene cloud/shadow contamination over target AOI must not exceed 5.0%; all cloud and shadow pixels must be 100% masked via QA bitmask so that exactly 0.00% unmasked invalid pixels enter metric computation.
quality_control_criteria.sensor_radiometric_consistency: Sensor compatibility is metric-specific: Thermal LST verification requires thermal radiometers (Landsat-8/9 TIRS USGS Collection 2 Level-2 or Drone Thermal Radiometric). Sentinel-2 MSI provides optical bands (NDVI/NDBI) and CANNOT directly measure thermal LST; no cross-sensor thermal equivalence is implied.
quality_control_criteria.geolocation_alignment: Observation spatial reference system (UTM Zone 43N / WGS84) must align with the canonical analytical framework with native spatial resolution <= 30m; sub-pixel coregistration (< 0.5 pixels / 15m) is a QC requirement pending executable validation on raw scene delivery.

execution_blockers: No physical cooling interventions have yet been deployed in Pune under CLIMORA.
Post-implementation satellite overpasses do not yet exist.
Matched control unit counterfactual baseline requires post-intervention temporal synchronization.
difference_in_differences_status.intervention_implementation_note: Intervention-specific establishment periods (e.g. 24-36 months for urban street tree sapling canopy growth) are physical civil deployment considerations, NOT universal mathematical prerequisites for the DID estimator.

mandatory_sections: 12. End-to-End Data Lake Lineage & Cryptographic Provenance

synthetic_fixture_isolation_policy.label: DEMO_ONLY_SYNTHETIC_MRV_DATA
synthetic_fixture_isolation_policy.isolation_mandate: Any synthetic implementation or verification test data generated for UI/demo purposes must carry this exact label and is strictly prohibited from entering production parquet datasets or setting canonical project status to VERIFIED.
